HPINBAR.VisibleToHint: Who reads the exact HP on a token's bar. Anyone who can see the bar still sees the bar itself.
HPINBAR.VisibleToOwner: The token's owners and the GM
HPINBAR.VisibleToEveryone: Everyone who can see the bar
HPINBAR.FontSizeHint: Font size for the HP text inside the token health bar.
HPINBAR.StrokeColorHint: Outline colour for readability against the bar background.
HPINBAR.StrokeWidthHint: Thickness of the text outline in pixels.
HPINBAR.AcVisibleToHint: Who gets the AC shield on a token's health bar, and the AC box in the token HUD. Anyone who can edit the actor can change it from the HUD.
HPINBAR.AcTooltip: Armor Class. Type +2 or -2 to adjust it, or the AC you want. 0 or empty clears the adjustment.
HPINBAR.AcTooltipAdjusted: {base} calculated, {adjustment} adjustment. 0 or empty clears it.
HPINBAR.AcTooltipOverride: {value}, set by hand in the sheet's armour settings. Edits here change that number.
HPINBAR.AcMismatch: HP & AC in Bar: the AC should now be {expected}, but the system shows {now}. Its armour calculation may not use bonuses; check the sheet.
HPINBAR.AcWarning: Warn When the AC Doesn't Add Up
HPINBAR.AcWarningHint: After an edit in the token HUD, warn if the AC the system shows isn't the one you typed. Off by default, since effects and features that change AC on their own can set it off.
HPINBAR.TempShieldHint: Draws temporary hit points as a see-through blue shield over the health bar, instead of only dnd5e's thin stripe. The +12 next to the HP numbers shows either way.
